children.name: Count of rules triggered per client

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly ("\"waf_executed\":\"1\"") 
| json "client_ip", "waf_executed", "waf_rule_id" as client_ip, waf_executed, waf_rule_id nodrop
| where waf_executed = "1"
| count_distinct(waf_rule_id) as unique_threats by client_ip 
| top 10 client_ip by unique_threats

children.name: Fastly - WAF - OWASP
children.description: See the overall OWASP anomaly score quartiles and by rule category.

panels.name: OWASP (overall)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly ("\"waf_executed\":\"1\"" "waf_anomaly_score")
| json "waf_executed", "waf_anomaly_score" as waf_executed, waf_anomaly_score nodrop 
| where waf_executed="1"
| min(waf_anomaly_score) as min, pct(waf_anomaly_score, 25) as lower, pct(waf_anomaly_score, 50) as median, pct(waf_anomaly_score, 75) as upper, max(waf_anomaly_score) as max, avg(waf_anomaly_score) as avg

panels.name: HTTP Violations (921xxx_rules)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly ("\"waf_executed\": \"1\"" "waf_http_score")
| json "waf_executed", "waf_http_score" as waf_executed, waf_http_score nodrop
| where waf_executed="1" and waf_http_score >= 0
| min(waf_http_score) as min, pct(waf_http_score, 25) as lower, pct(waf_http_score, 50) as median, pct(waf_http_score, 75) as upper, max(waf_http_score) as max, avg(waf_http_score) as avg

panels.name: Inbound HTTP (920xxx_rules)

| json "waf_executed", "waf_anomaly_score", "waf_rule_id" as waf_executed, waf_anomaly_score, waf_rule_id nodrop

(waf_anomaly_score >= 0) and 
(waf_rule_id >= 920000) and 
(waf_rule_id <= 920999) | min(waf_anomaly_score) as min, pct(waf_anomaly_score, 25) as lower, pct(waf_anomaly_score, 50) as median, pct(waf_anomaly_score, 75) as upper, max(waf_anomaly_score) as max, avg(waf_anomaly_score) as avg

children.name: Fastly - WAF - Offenders
children.description: See the details on WAF offenders including the location, client IP addresses for warning and blocked events, and OWASP offenders in different attack categories and threshold exceptions.

panels.name: Geo Location of All Users
panels.queryString:
// shows user location based on client_ip when waf ruleset is executed
(_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly OR _sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly) ("\"waf_executed\":\"1\"") 
| json "waf_executed", "client_ip" as waf_executed, client_ip nodrop
| where waf_executed = "1"
| count as count by client_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = client_ip
| if (isBlank(country_name), "unknown", country_name) as country_name
| count by latitude, longitude, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort by country_name

panels.name: Top Clients Affected by Threats
panels.queryString:
(_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly OR _sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly) ("\"waf_executed\":\"1\"") 
| json "client_ip", "waf_executed", "waf_rule_id", "url" as client_ip, waf_executed, waf_rule_id, url nodrop
| where waf_executed = "1"
| "Other" as threatCategory
| if (waf_rule_id matches "101*", "ThresholdException", threatCategory) as threatCategory
| if (waf_rule_id matches "920*" or waf_rule_id matches "921*", "HTTP", threatCategory) as threatCategory
| if (waf_rule_id matches "930*" or waf_rule_id matches "931*" or waf_rule_id matches "932*", "LFI_RCE_RFI", threatCategory) as threatCategory
| if (waf_rule_id matches "933*", "PHP", threatCategory) as threatCategory
| if (waf_rule_id matches "941*", "XSS", threatCategory) as threatCategory
| if (waf_rule_id matches "942*", "SQLInjection", threatCategory) as threatCategory
| if (waf_rule_id matches "943*", "SessionFixation", threatCategory) as threatCategory
| count_distinct(threatCategory) as unique_threat_category by client_ip 
| top 10 client_ip by unique_threat_category

panels.name: Client IP (Warn)
panels.queryString:
(_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly OR _sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly) ("client_ip" "waf_logged") (MISS* OR NONE* OR PASS*)
| json "client_ip", "cache_status", "waf_logged", "waf_block", "waf_passed", "waf_anomaly_score" as client_ip, cache_status, waf_logged, waf_block, waf_passed, waf_anomaly_score nodrop
| where ! isEmpty (waf_logged) and ((waf_logged = "1" and waf_block = "0") or (waf_passed = "1" and waf_anomaly_score > 0)) and (cache_status matches "MISS*" or cache_status matches "PASS*" or cache_status matches "NONE*")
| count as warns by client_ip
| sort by warns

panels.name: Client IP (Blocked)
panels.queryString:
(_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly OR _sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly) ("\"waf_block\":\"1\"" and "\"cache_status\":\"ERROR\"")
| json "client_ip","cache_status","waf_block" as client_ip, cache_status, waf_block nodrop
| where waf_block="1" and cache_status matches "ERROR"
| count as block by client_ip
| sort by block

panels.name: Overall Threat Trends
panels.queryString:
(_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly OR _sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly) ("\"waf_executed\":\"1\"") 
| json "client_ip", "waf_executed", "waf_rule_id" as client_ip, waf_executed, waf_rule_id nodrop
| where waf_executed = "1"
| if (waf_rule_id matches "101*", 1, 0) as ThresholdException
| if (waf_rule_id matches "920*" or waf_rule_id matches "921*", 1, 0) as HTTP
| if (waf_rule_id matches "930*" or waf_rule_id matches "931*" or waf_rule_id matches "932*", 1, 0) as LFI_RCE_RFI
| if (waf_rule_id matches "933*", 1, 0) as PHP
| if (waf_rule_id matches "941*", 1, 0) as XSS
| if (waf_rule_id matches "942*", 1, 0) as SQLInjection
| if (waf_rule_id matches "943*", 1, 0) as SessionFixation
| timeslice 1h
| sum (ThresholdException) as ThresholdExceptions, sum (HTTP) as HTTPs, sum (LFI_RCE_RFI) as LFI_RCE_RFIs, sum (PHP) as PHPs, sum (XSS) as XSS, sum (SQLInjection) as SQLInjections, sum (SessionFixation) as SessionFixations by _timeslice

children.name: Fastly - WAF - Overview
children.description: See the overview of Fastly WAF including the states, hits, and threat intel on warning and blocked events.

panels.name: WAF States
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly ("\"waf_executed\":\"1\"")
| json "waf_failures", "waf_logged", "waf_passed", "waf_anomaly_score", "waf_block", "waf_executed" as waf_failures, waf_logged, waf_passed, waf_anomaly_score, waf_block, waf_executed nodrop
//review logs that went through waf ruleset 
| where waf_executed="1"
| timeslice 15m
//capture different use cases - log, block, pass, failure(error)
| if ((waf_logged = "1" and waf_block = "0") or (waf_passed = "1" and waf_anomaly_score > 0),1,0) as waf_logged
| if (waf_failures = "1",1,0) as waf_failures
| if (waf_block = "1",1,0) as waf_block
| if (waf_passed = "1" and (waf_logged = "0" and waf_block= "0"),1,0) as waf_passed
| sum(waf_logged) as warn, sum(waf_failures) as error, sum(waf_block) as bad, sum(waf_passed) as good by _timeslice

panels.name: Daily Hits
panels.queryString:
//log count within 24h timeslice through waf ruleset 
_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly ("waf_executed")
| json "waf_executed" as waf_executed nodrop
| timeslice 24h
| if (!isBlank(waf_executed) and waf_executed = "1",1,0) as waf_executed
| sum (waf_executed) as hits by _timeslice

panels.name: Top URLS (Warn)
panels.queryString:
(_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly OR _sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly) ("\"waf_executed\":\"1\"")
| json "url", "waf_logged", "waf_passed", "waf_block", "waf_anomaly_score","waf_executed" as url, waf_logged, waf_passed, waf_block, waf_anomaly_score, waf_executed nodrop
//review logs that went through waf ruleset and where URL is logged but not blocked (monitor mode) or where URL is logged and not blocked due to not exceeding threshold settings (block mode)
| where waf_executed="1" and ((waf_logged = "1" and waf_block = "0") or (waf_passed = "1" and waf_anomaly_score > 0))
| count as warns by url
| top 10 url by warns
| urldecode(url) as url

panels.name: Top URLS (Blocked)
panels.queryString:
(_sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly OR _sourceCategory = Labs/Fastly) ("\"waf_executed\":\"1\"" "\"waf_block\":\"1\"")
| json "url", "status", "waf_executed", "waf_block" as url, status, waf_executed, waf_block nodrop
//show Top URLs blocked within reporting time window
| where waf_executed="1" and waf_block="1"
| count as block by url, status
| top 10 url, status by block
| urldecode(url) as url
